topic: The doctor advised me to rest
title: The doctor advised me to rest
pt: Foco da aula: comandos reportados: told me to / asked me not to

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

group90.name: Pausa
group90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Leo, you are limping! Did you finally go to the clinic about your knee?
lines.pt: Leo, você está mancando! Finalmente foi à clínica por causa do joelho?

lines.en: Yes. The doctor examined it and told me to rest for two weeks. I was shocked.
lines.pt: Fui. A médica examinou e mandou eu descansar por duas semanas. Fiquei chocado.

lines.en: Two weeks? Did she tell you to stay in bed, or just to avoid running?
lines.pt: Duas semanas? Ela mandou você ficar na cama ou só evitar correr?

lines.en: She told me not to run or climb stairs. She also asked me not to carry anything heavy.
lines.pt: Ela mandou eu não correr nem subir escadas. Também me pediu para não carregar nada pesado.

lines.en: That is sensible. Did she advise you to take any medicine for the pain?
lines.pt: É sensato. Ela aconselhou você a tomar algum remédio para a dor?

lines.en: She told me to take two tablets a day, and she told me not to skip any.
lines.pt: Ela mandou eu tomar dois comprimidos por dia e disse para eu não pular nenhum.

lines.en: And what about work? Did she tell you to stay home or to go back soon?
lines.pt: E o trabalho? Ela mandou você ficar em casa ou voltar logo?

lines.en: She advised me to work from home. My boss asked me to send a medical certificate.
lines.pt: Ela me aconselhou a trabalhar de casa. Meu chefe me pediu para mandar um atestado médico.

lines.en: Good idea. I will remind you to do your exercises. She must have told you to do some.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Vou lembrar você de fazer os exercícios. Ela deve ter mandado você fazer alguns.

lines.en: Yes, she told me to stretch every morning. I will ask you for help if I need it.
lines.pt: Sim, ela mandou eu me alongar toda manhã. Vou pedir sua ajuda se precisar.

lines.en: Please do. The receptionist asked me to remind you about your appointment on Friday.
lines.pt: Peça mesmo. A recepcionista me pediu para lembrar você da consulta de sexta.

items.wrong: The doctor said me to rest.

items.why: Use told me to, nunca said me to.

items.wrong: She told me do not run.

items.wrong: He asked me that I send it.

Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.

facts.big: The doctor told me to rest
facts.label: Comandos reportados
facts.sub: Use told, asked ou advised + pessoa + to + verbo: She told me to rest. Para negar, use not to: She told me not to run.

facts.label: mandou eu
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + to + verbo: The doctor told me to rest. É a forma mais comum para reportar ordens. O verbo fica na forma base depois de to.

facts.label: pediu para eu
facts.sub: Use asked + pessoa + to + verbo para pedidos educados: My boss asked me to send a certificate. É mais suave que told.

facts.label: para não + verbo

facts.sub: Use advised + pessoa + to + verbo para conselhos: She advised me to work from home. Também pode usar recommended, mas a estrutura muda.

compare.ask: The doctor told me to rest.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “a médica mandou eu descansar” ou “pediu para eu não correr”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The doctor told me to rest.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use told / asked / advised + pessoa + to + verbo: She told me to rest. Para negar, coloque not antes de to: She told me not to run. Não use that nem do.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “She told me to rest”.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: The negative is “She told me do not run”.
items.why: The negative is told me not to run.

items.s: Asked me to means made a polite request.
items.why: Yes.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: We say “She told me to rest”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The negative is “She told me do not run”. → Falso (The negative is told me not to run.)
Asked me to means made a polite request. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

items.s: We use that after told in commands.

answers: We use that after told in commands. → Falso (We use told + person + to + verb.)

pages.title: A clinic in Seattle · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey Monday morning in Seattle. Blake waits outside a small clinic. Leo comes out slowly, holding a paper bag. He has just seen the doctor about his knee. Blake wants to know every detail. Today they practise reporting commands and advice.

“Leo, you are limping! Did you finally go to the clinic about your knee?” says Blake. “Yes. The doctor examined it and told me to rest for two weeks. I was shocked.” says Leo. “Two weeks? Did she tell you to stay in bed, or just to avoid running?” says Blake.
